title: Topological Charge Asymmetry in a $\mathbb{C}\mathrm{P}^N$ Skyrmion-Fermion Coupled System
summary: Topology plays a central role in classifying solitonic configurations in field theories, providing robustness and a nonperturbative label, the so-called topological charge $Q$. In soliton-fermion coupled systems, the relation between the topological charge and the number of zero modes is well established through the index theorem. However, the physical consequences of the sign of the topological charge have remained largely unexplored.
